name: KITAS Tanggungan -- Spouse of Indonesian Citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a lawful marriage to an Indonesian citizen, with the marriage certificate translated and legalized if issued abroad. The Indonesian spouse must sponsor the application and demonstrate sufficient financial capacity to support the foreign spouse.

evidence_required.document: Indonesian spouse's ID and proof of financial capacity

sources.title: Kusuma Law Firm -- KITAS Tanggungan for spouse/family: 6-12 month duration, no independent work rights unless separately authorised

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Indonesia's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: sourced from a tier-3 Indonesian law firm rather than imigrasi.go.id directly (which was largely unreachable in this pass). work_rights explicitly 'none' per the source -- dependent KITAS holders (including spouses) cannot work unless they separately obtain work authorisation, a materially restrictive design point worth flagging plainly. pr_after_months (24): Law 12/2006's Article 19 confirms (at tier-1, see id_naturalisation) that a reduced naturalisation track exists for spouses of Indonesian citizens via a simple 'pernyataan' (statement) rather than full naturalisation, but the EXACT years-of-marriage/residence threshold for that statement track was not confirmed at tier-1 or a reliable tier-3 source in this pass (jogja.kemenkum.go.id's dedicated page on this could not be fetched -- DNS/robots errors) -- 24 months is a commonly cited figure in secondary sources but is NOT independently verified here and should not be treated as confirmed.
